method: Independent read-only review; no application source mutation or test rerun. Public backend controls are separate soxr-public-build artifacts.
checked: Planner creates and destroys its own wrapper/backend. Every cursor constructs a new owned opaque handle; filter history cannot leak between cursors or count planning. Swift deinit calls native destroy.

Finite integral8k..192k rates and stereo array/count bounds are validated before allocation. C count guards bound resulting count<=16m before Swift count*2 allocations and Int64 conversion. Equal-rate mode2 is deliberately admitted, without the mode0 transparent-copy assumption.

The loop sends positive input blocks<=8192, with final=true exactly on the last source block. It does not follow this by a second zero-input flush. Count prediction uses the same block size and terminal policy.
Native zero-output blocks still advance inputPosition and native state and continue the loop; they are not mistaken for EOF. Produced count must match prediction.

Seeking always rebuilds filter state from source zero, executes identical blocks, drops complete preroll blocks and retains the exact gained crossing-block suffix. End seek emits nothing. This remains an application policy.
The shared source renderer applies event gain only for original-rate mode. Converted modes filter raw verified PCM, then apply the separate Float32 event gain exactly once.

Planar conversion still routes output through existing stereo ring in<=8192-frame transfer chunks, even when one resampling output block exceeds ring admission. Channel indexing remains interleaved L/R into planar L/R.

AudioTransportEngine keeps the existing four-buffer queue, generation-gated dataPlayedBack callbacks and end conditions. Processing errors throw; callback path records failure and stops/releases cursor. Initial preparation errors exit source mode through StudioSession catch.

Inspection is eligibility information; actual Play/resume/seek replays source/report/media proof in configureCPRSourceEvent. Unresolved original events are preserved and normal project playback/export barriers remain separate.

Explicit picker/display labels distinguish original rate, mode0 and public-SoXR mode2. Caption states public0.1.3 and unverified reference sample equivalence. No automatic native availability or mode1 fallback claim is introduced.
limits: No direct re-execution of GUI or Cubase. Test outcomes remain attributed to their separately retained logs and independent wrapper oracle.
A post-conversion gain error occurs after converter/input state advances. Caller must discard the failed cursor, as current engine/session error paths do; the cursor is not generally transactional.

A count planner predicts native-wrapper returned counts, not public library produced samples or actual native runtime output. Backend underproduction/retained storage behavior is the separate C wrapper contract.

Resident source PCM, main-actor refill, four-buffer queue, 8192-input partitioning and reset/preroll seek do not establish native live callback topology, hard realtime operation or device-rate sample equivalence.
Exact public backend equality with proprietary SoXR source/build remains unverified.
